items.item_text: 01. How have you demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students?
02. Please describe in detail how your educational background and professional experiences have prepared you for this position and the strengths that you would bring.
03. What is your approach to people with lifestyles and/or cultures other than yours? Please give one or more examples of your experiences with patients of different cultural backgrounds.

04. Are you comfortable discussing sexual or reproductive concerns with patients, sexually transmitted infections, gay/lesbian/bisexual/transgender sexual concerns, emergency contraception, abortion and mental health concerns? Please share a situation where you handled this well.
05. What interests you about this position, including which aspects of the role you feel most prepared for and those aspects of the student health role that are most challenging for you?
06. This position requires a valid California Registered Nurse License. Please provide your license number.
07. This position requires a valid Healthcare Provider CPR/AED certificate. Please provide the date of completion.
08. This position requires a valid California driver license. Do you hold one? Options: Yes | No

09. This is in-house-only recruitment: This position is open to internal permanent and temporary Coast Community College District (CCCD) employees to apply. External candidates are NOT eligible to apply. If you are not a current employee with CCCD, please do not apply at this time. Are you currently employed by the Coast Community College District as an active employee? Options: Yes | No
10. Provide your Employee ID #.

11. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. Responses to supplemental questions (clear and detailed responses are required as they will be carefully evaluated to determine the most qualified candidate(s) to be invited for an interview; please do not paste your resume, or put "see resume", or "N/A" or leave blank) Options: Yes | No

12. Please confirm that all responses provided in this application are your own original work and were not generated or assisted by artificial intelligence tools or software. By answering 'Yes,' you attest to the authenticity of your responses. Options: Yes | No
